# Cache fleet operating notes

These rules are still true. The fleet itself was retired, and the rules that
kept it correct did not change with it: one writer per key, no entry outlives
its source, and a rebuild starts from the source of truth. The archive keeps the
note because it explains the retired tree, and the archived corpus is
read-only.
